items.headline: 49th ASEAN Summit Opens in Manila to Focus on Regional Unity and Economic Growth
items.summary: On November 15, 2026, Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. officially opened the 49th ASEAN Summit in Manila, bringing together Southeast Asian leaders to address pressing regional challenges. The high-level gathering focuses on strengthening economic integration, navigating geopolitical tensions, and fostering collective security across the Asia-Pacific region.

items.headline: NASA's Voyager 1 Reaches Historic One Light-Day Distance Record
items.summary: NASA's Voyager 1 spacecraft is reaching a historic milestone by becoming the first human-made object to travel a distance of one light-day from Earth. NASA is celebrating this interstellar achievement by inviting the public to shine Morse code light signals into the night sky.

items.headline: England Defeats Spain 3-2 to End Historic 43-Match Unbeaten Streak
items.summary: England defeated reigning World and European champion Spain 3-2 in a UEFA Nations League match in Madrid on November 15, 2026. The victory ended Spain's record 43-game unbeaten streak across all competitions and gave England their first-ever away victory against a top-ranked FIFA nation.

items.headline: BTS and IVE Win Top Grand Prizes at the 2026 Melon Music Awards
items.summary: South Korean group BTS won major grand prizes, including Artist of the Year and Album of the Year, at the 2026 Melon Music Awards in Seoul on November 15. The ceremony concluded a two-day celebration of the year's top music achievements, with girl group IVE also taking home Song of the Year.
